title: RacketCon 2013: Dan Liebgold - Racket on the Playstation 3? It's Not What you Think!
summary: Dan Liebgold of Naughty Dog gives a RacketCon 2013 keynote on using Racket in PlayStation 3 game development. He explains the Racket-based DSLs used for game data and scripting, which replaced the studio's earlier GOAL-based toolchain.
why: HN cites it whenever Lisp in games, Naughty Dog or Racket in production comes up, as the main first-hand account.

quote.text: There's a talk by one of the engine devs at RacketCon from a few years ago on youtube about how they use these DSLs
